name: Stars The
overview: Scripture reveals that stars are created by God and set in the heavens to give light upon the earth and to serve as signs for seasons, days, and years, demonstrating His sovereign design over creation (Genesis 1:14, 17). They are innumerable and symbolize God's promise to Abraham of a vast seed (Genesis 15:5). Stars also carry messianic significance, as seen in the prophecy of a Star arising from Jacob, pointing to Christ's coming reign (Numbers 24:17). Furthermore, God warns against idolatry involving the sun, moon, and stars, emphasizing that these celestial bodies are appointed by Him and not to be worshipped (Deuteronomy 4:19).
